questions.q: Which question does business metadata answer, per this lesson?
options: What is this, structurally?
What does this mean to the business?
What actually happened to this data?
How much does this data cost to store?
questions.explain: Business metadata covers definitions, business rules, and ownership — the meaning of the data, not its structure or processing history.

questions.q: In the worked example, which type of metadata states that CustomerLifetimeValueUSD is a DECIMAL(18,2) column?
options: Business metadata
Operational metadata
Technical metadata
None of the three — this is a different kind of fact entirely
questions.explain: Data type, length, and constraints are structural facts — exactly what technical metadata describes.

questions.q: According to this lesson, which of the three metadata types is generated automatically by pipelines and schedulers?
options: Business metadata
Operational metadata
Technical metadata
All three are generated automatically with no human involvement
questions.explain: Operational metadata — last refresh time, row counts, job duration — comes from the systems that move and process the data, not from a person writing it down.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say business metadata is different from the other two types?
options: It is the one type that has to be deliberately written by a person
It is the only type that ever changes over time
It is the only type stored in a database
It is less important than technical metadata
questions.explain: Technical and operational metadata are produced automatically by existing systems; business metadata requires a steward or subject matter expert to actually write the definition and context.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what commonly goes wrong when someone asks 'is this table good?'
options: They get a technically-correct answer to what was actually a business or operational question
The question is always impossible to answer with any kind of metadata
The table is deleted before anyone can respond
Business metadata is the only type that can ever answer this question
questions.explain: The question could be asking about meaning (business), structure (technical), or freshness (operational) — answering with the wrong type leaves the real question unaddressed even though the answer given was accurate.
